en: The image depicts a large triumphal arch reminiscent of the Arc de Triomphe in Paris, but with distinct differences and local elements. The arch is made of light-colored stone and features ornate carvings, inscriptions in Latin, royal crowns, and military emblems. There are two cars in the foreground that appear to be from the 1970s or 1980s. The weather is clear and sunny, and there are trees visible behind the monument.
